# The references

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m docs.build` from the shipped references and the user guide's table of
     references. Do not edit by hand. -->

These 15 starting points are rendered by the code that ships. Each sound is the reference's
own take, matched in loudness at −27 LUFS like every reference, so turn them up together;
the report is what `halyard render` prints for it, and the patch is what `halyard init`
writes. The figures show the level over time, in dB below the peak, and the whole
hit's spectrum, smoothed over a sixth of an octave.

- [`tone`](#tone)
- [`crack`](#crack)
- [`fat`](#fat)
- [`driven`](#driven)
- [`clap`](#clap)
- [`snap`](#snap)
- [`machine`](#machine)
- [`house`](#house)
- [`short-clap`](#short-clap)
- [`rim-click`](#rim-click)
- [`big-clap`](#big-clap)
- [`long-snare`](#long-snare)
- [`rimshot`](#rimshot)
- [`cross-stick`](#cross-stick)
- [`brush`](#brush)

## tone

Two tonal modes and a soft click over bright, snappy noise; round and clearly pitched. Try: tuning, damping, the second mode's level.

![The tone reference: its level over time and its spectrum](figures/tone.svg)

[Listen to tone](audio/tone.wav) · `halyard init tone > tone.toml`

```
tuning   196.000 Hz, G3 +0.0 cents; modes 196.0, 312.2 Hz
length   220.0 ms source, 221.9 ms exported (10651 samples at 48000 Hz, float32), seed 1
peak     -9.13 dBFS sample, -8.61 dBTP true
loudness -27.0 LUFS, the largest 400 ms momentary loudness (BS.1770)
domain   inside the validated domain: predicted aliasing -162 dB, margin 62.3 dB
         mostly kinks, 42% at body.amp[2] (0.3 ms); drive headroom +27.9 dB
```

<details><summary>The patch</summary>

```toml
instrument = "snare"
schema = 1
seed = 1

[body]
tune_hz  = 196.0
level_db = -3.0
damping  = 1.0              # mode i decays ratio^damping times faster
modes = [                   # loudest mode exactly 0 dB
  { ratio = 1.0,   level_db = 0.0 },
  { ratio = 1.593, level_db = -6.0 },
]
pitch = [                   # ratio to tune_hz; starts at 0 ms, ends at 1
  { ms = 0.0,  ratio = 1.06 },
  { ms = 12.0, ratio = 1.0 },
]
amp = [                     # shape: 0 at both ends, highest point exactly 1
  { ms = 0.0,   gain = 0.0 },
  { ms = 0.3,   gain = 1.0 },
  { ms = 20.0,  gain = 0.6 },
  { ms = 70.0,  gain = 0.25 },
  { ms = 160.0, gain = 0.05 },
  { ms = 220.0, gain = 0.0 },
]

[[noise]]                   # noise[1]
level_db = -18.0
band_hz  = [1000.0, 12000.0]
rattle   = 0.0              # 0 … 1, gated at the body's fundamental
amp = [
  { ms = 0.0,  gain = 0.0 },
  { ms = 0.15, gain = 1.0 },
  { ms = 0.3,  gain = 0.6 },
  { ms = 3.0,  gain = 0.1 },
  { ms = 8.0,  gain = 0.0 },
]

[[noise]]                   # noise[2]
level_db = -9.0
band_hz  = [2000.0, 11000.0]
rattle   = 0.2              # 0 … 1, gated at the body's fundamental
amp = [
  { ms = 0.0,   gain = 0.0 },
  { ms = 1.0,   gain = 1.0 },
  { ms = 30.0,  gain = 0.4 },
  { ms = 110.0, gain = 0.1 },
  { ms = 200.0, gain = 0.0 },
]

[drive]
db = 2.0                    # small-signal gain; 0 = bypass

[output]
sample_rate = 48000
format      = "float32"     # "float32" | "pcm24" | "pcm16"
mode        = "gain"        # "gain" | "peak" | "true-peak"
db          = -11.1         # gain in dB, or peak target in dBFS
polarity    = 1
```

## crack

![The crack reference: its level over time and its spectrum](figures/crack.svg)
